fusions.name: Unheard Pounce
fusions.desc: Pounces up to 6 tiles onto a target, dealing 30 damage as a critical hit and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hind-Claw Rake
fusions.desc: Grabs a target carrying one of your afflictions, uses that affliction up and rakes it with both hind feet, dealing 8 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Righting Twist
fusions.desc: For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you twist 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Unbroken Fall
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
